quarantine.mr_name: ALT allele permutation with consistent GT and Number=A/R/G remapping
preconditions: header_has_info_number_a OR header_has_info_number_r OR header_has_info_number_g OR header_has_format_number_a OR header_has_format_number_r OR header_has_format_number_g
quarantine.oracle: After permuting ALT alleles and consistently remapping GT indices and Number=A/R/G fields, the parsed variant record must represent the same set of variant alleles and genotypes. For each sample, the original and transformed GT must decode to the same set of alleles (REF/ALT strings). Number=A fields must be reordered by the same permutation as ALT. Number=R fields must keep the REF value at index 0 and reorder ALT values by the permutation. Number=G fields must be remapped according to the new genotype index ordering.

evidence.quote: ALT: alternate base(s); comma-separated list of alternate non-reference alleles. The alleles in this list are used as reference alleles in subsequent genotype fields.

GT: genotype, encoded as allele values separated by either of / or |, e.g. 0/1 or 1|0. The allele values are 0 for the reference allele (what is in the REF field), 1 for the first allele in ALT, 2 for the second allele in ALT, etc.
Number=A means one value per alternate allele; Number=R means one value for each allele including the reference; Number=G means one value for each possible genotype.
